summary: A treatment question that is really a scheduling question.

items.task: Being treated, and health insurance entitlement
items.note: Hospitals identify patients by passport or registration card, and NHIS entitlement does not arise from a phone number. 'No number means no insurance check' is inaccurate.

items.task: Registering in a hospital or booking app
items.note: Where the app asks for phone identity verification, sign-up or patient-record linking stops there.

items.task: Appointment changes, results and prescription alerts
items.note: Sent to a domestic number. Losing them is inconvenience rather than exclusion, and it compounds.
Reception still works the way it always did.

source: National Health Insurance Service coverage rules for foreign residents
